edit.description: Replace the STRIPPED_VARS hardcoded-list assertion (~L654-690) with a generic /^FLUME_/-prefix check per derived-state section — e2db3e4 widened the pin to 5 vars but still hand-syncs a literal list against hermeticEnv()'s actual delete-set, reintroducing the staleness class the entry it shipped was filed to close.

summary: hermeticEnv pin still hardcodes STRIPPED_VARS instead of asserting no FLUME_-prefixed key survives, so a future stripped var again needs a manual test-side sync

per.section: Derived state is computed, never restated beside its source

tests: hermeticEnv() leaves no key matching /^FLUME_/ in its returned env, so a future var added to its strip set is caught without any test-side edit
acceptance: cli.test.ts's hermeticEnv pin fails if a new FLUME_* var is added to hermeticEnv() without being stripped, with zero test-side changes required
notes: hermeticEnv() (subprocess.ts:40-46) has no exported list to derive from — it's 5 individual delete statements — so the robust fix asserts the invariant directly (no /^FLUME_/ key survives) rather than deriving a list. This was the original entry's own notes recommendation; e2db3e4 took the hardcoded-list path instead.
